_comment: Whitelist of geometry/paint props sanctioned by scripts/prop-rubric.mjs. Only caller-OWNED identity / data-driven PAINT is sanctioned here (ADR 0003: a scenario's accent, a participant's colour, a chart series' colour stay as `color: string` because an internal series index would break the caller's contract). Geometry lengths (width/height/min/max/size) are NEVER whitelisted here — they must become semantic (number/token) props. `allow[relativeFilePath][propName] = reason`.

src/components/Cell/Cell.tsx.color: Caller/data-driven cell text colour (ADR 0003 data-driven paint).

src/components/Chart/CurrentValueIndicat.color: Chart series current-value dot colour, caller/series-owned (ADR 0003).

src/components/Chart/Series.tsx.color: Reference-line colour override, caller-driven chart paint (ADR 0003).

src/components/Dot/Dot.tsx.color: Category/status dot identity colour, caller-owned (ADR 0003 Dropdown dot).

src/components/InlineText/InlineText.tsx.color: Explicitly data-driven text colour, the component's only input (ADR 0003).

src/components/Progress/StackedProgressB.background: Caller-driven track background paint (ADR 0003 data-driven paint).

src/components/Surface/Surface.tsx.borderColor: Caller-driven surface border tint (ADR 0003 data-driven paint).
